rules.title: CSF stories
rules.text: Write stories in Component Story Format with typed args.

rules.title: Story per state
rules.text: Add a story for each meaningful state, including loading, empty and error.

rules.title: Interaction tests
rules.text: Cover behavior with play functions and run the test runner in CI.

rules.title: A11y addon
rules.text: Keep the accessibility addon clean for every story.
